author: fullportnik
text:
it's nice to zoom out and think about what the market was like in the past and see if it will repeat itself in the future

i wrote to my substack on January 31st 2026, which is when a couple factors made the market very confusing:
 - gold and silver were ripping
 - kevin warsh just got nominated
 - spy / qqq chopping around at ATHs

at that moment, i did this "zoom out" exercise and found something that rhymes: when you have a popular asset ripping to the moon, it often marks a local top.

in this case, it was gold and silver.

i took nearly all my chips off the table in anticipation of a correction and that ended up being a very profitable move.

so how is this relevant now?

i don't think we put in like a 2-3 month top until something similar happens: a liquidity rush in some name(s) causing them to go nuclear. we could always have minor corrections from now until then.

what do you think those names could be?
